title: Zebra dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a2a55'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='60' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='70' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#d0d0e0'/>
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <rect x='36' y='50' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='48' width='6' height='24' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='50' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- front legs (dancing, raised) -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-25 26 62)'/>
  <rect x='22' y='60' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a' transform='rotate(-25 26 62)'/>
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a' transform='rotate(-25 26 62)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='48' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#d0d0e0' transform='rotate(30 72 57)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='54' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a' transform='rotate(30 72 57)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='48' width='8' height='5' fill='#4a4a7a' transform='rotate(30 72 57)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='12' height='28' rx='6' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <rect x='25' y='34' width='5' height='6' fill='#3a3a6a' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <rect x='25' y='44' width='5' height='6' fill='#3a3a6a' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <rect x='24' y='24' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <rect x='21' y='32' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8a8ac0' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <rect x='20' y='41' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a' transform='rotate(-15 30 44)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='24' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-20 20 24)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='11' cy='27' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#c0c0dc' transform='rotate(-20 11 27)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='22,14 26,8 28,16' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <polygon points='24,13 26,10 27,15' fill='#8a8ac0'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='21' r='2.2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='19.6' cy='20.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='28' r='1' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 54 Q82 48 78 40' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='39' r='3' fill='#8a8ac0'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M85 25 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z' fill='#ffd86b'/>
  <path d='M14 70 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#7bd8ff'/>
  <path d='M80 72 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#ff9bd8'/>
</svg>
